item.title: Dennis Hastert, longtime Republican House speaker who went to prison, dies at age 84
item.description:
Dennis Hastert, the longest-serving Republican speaker in U.S. history who later admitted sexually abusing several teenage boys, died Saturday at 84. The big picture: Hastert was the highest-ranking elected official in U.S. history to serve time in federal prison, and Congress still conducts business under an unwritten rule bearing his name. Driving the news: Hastert died at his home in Plano, Illinois, while under hospice care, the Kendall County Coroner's Office told Axios in an emailed statement. Catch up quick: Hastert pleaded guilty to evading banking laws in 2015 after prosecutors investigated him for concealing large cash withdrawals. Court proceedings revealed he paid hush money to cover up his past sexual abuse of boys while working as a teacher and high school wrestling coach.
